# What the `lint` job in workflows/kac.yml installs. Pinned, as that workflow pins its actions to a
# commit: a linter release changes what the gate rejects when the pin moves, not on its own. Dependabot
# moves these.
#
# actionlint runs in the same job and is not here: it is a Go binary with no pip package, so the job
# pins its version in the `go install` line and the header there says what it pins today.
